source.citation: J. W. Taylor (Chicago), 'Kimball, William W., Residence (1801 S. Prairie Ave.)', photograph no. 19825, c. 1895. what_it_does_not_supply: the plan: the 1911 Sanborn sheet 28's trace controls it
the south and east sides and the rear, which the camera does not see
colour (monochrome print); 'Bedford stone' is the register's reading
anything changed between c. 1895 and 1 July 1904
what_it_supplies: the massing as built: the front, the flank and the east range, their storeys and heights at the photograph's scale
the round tower's place on the 18th Street flank (not at the corner), its girth, its eaves and the height of its cone
the steep slate roof over the main block, its deck and cresting, its dormers
the south pavilion's stone gable, the bowed bay and the corner loggia with its arches and stair
the east turret at the far end of the flank
